headline: Make reporting gaps reviewable before an authorized filing
capabilities: Predict failures with real-time analysis and automated planning
Automate permit tracking and renewals with intelligent workflows
Generate audit-ready reports quickly with streamlined data collection
Consolidate fragmented data into real-time insights for easy centralized monitoring
outcomes: Improved asset reliability, reducing unplanned downtime and costs
Maintained compliance and operational continuity across facilities
Streamlined compliance reporting and minimized audit risk
Gained real-time visibility and strategic planning support to achieve emissions goals
why_try: A reporting lead can ask what is overdue or incomplete and receive the exact report, evidence gap, owner, and approval boundary.

sample_prompts.label: Regulatory Reporting Lead: Reporting portfolio status
sample_prompts.prompt: Which filing is overdue and who owns it?

sample_prompts.label: Data Analyst: Source-data validation screening
sample_prompts.prompt: Which report data is incomplete or below quality threshold?

sample_prompts.label: Compliance Manager: Read-only filing-state tracker
sample_prompts.prompt: Show filing state and confirm you did not transmit anything.

sample_prompts.label: Internal Auditor: Audit evidence triage
sample_prompts.prompt: What high-severity reporting evidence is still open?

sample_prompts.label: Environmental Manager: Quarterly emissions summary
sample_prompts.prompt: I need to prepare our quarterly EPA emissions report. Can you pull the data?

sample_prompts.label: Regulatory Affairs Director: Draft EPA submission package
sample_prompts.prompt: Generate the EPA submission file for the quarter and show me any compliance risks.

business_flow: Compliance managers, regulatory reporting leads, data analysts, and internal auditors
Approved filing connector and Microsoft Teams
